PermissionSet.description: Credential access only (build 49): the Git and Slack credential principals Release Relay calls through. In every Release Relay permission set group. RLY_Org_Self is not packaged: put its principal on your own permission set RLY_Org_Self_Access and add that to each group (a deploy of this set replaces its principal list).
PermissionSet.label: Release Relay Access
